source.title: DROID (100-episode sample)
source.citation: Khazatsky et al., DROID: A Large-Scale In-the-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset, RSS 2024
notes: Only end-effector positions and gripper are imported; orientation is not used (Nimbotics IK is position-only).
Objects in the real scene are not modelled in simulation.

selection: task described; 5–20 s; end effector >= 5 cm above the base plane and <= 0.78 m from the shoulder; moves >= 0.4 m; first 8

episodes.task: Put the marker in the pot
Put the candy bar on the left side of the first shelf
Put one green sachet in the grey bowl.
Place the pack of doritos inside the sink
Move the sharpie to the table
Take the pen out of the bowl and place it on the table
Put the orange rubber duck into the pot
Use the duster to wipe the whiteboard
